The '''FLLA''' is the international governing body of [[Arraby]]. It is composed of seven continental confederations: [[ATFVL]] ([[Atirha]]), [[AYFVL]] ([[Ayuma]]), [[NAFVL]] ([[New Ayre]]), [[MAFVL]] ([[Mahea]]), [[QUFVL]] ([[Quia]]), [[MSFVL]] ([[Massir]]) and [[ACFVL]] ([[Acrola]]).

The FLLA organises the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international Arraby tournament. The most recent edition was the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]], won by [[Easuhura]].
